reports.title: Ceribell Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results

guidance.heading: 2026 Financial Outlook
section: Ceribell is raising its revenue guidance for the full year 2026 to a range of $115 million to $117 million, representing growth of approximately 29% to 31% over the Company’s prior year revenue. This update reflects the Company’s continued momentum in its core business, driven by both new account additions and increased utilization within its established account base. The updated range does not include material contributions from the Company’s neonate, pediatric, or delirium products.
